description: This PHP source file defines the PimDefinedReportAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing PIM (personal information management) reports in the OrangeHRM system. The class includes methods for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting PIM report definitions, with integrated validation and transaction handling. It interacts with services, DAOs, and models to perform CRUD operations and supports API documentation annotations.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing PIM defined reports, supporting CRUD operations and listing with validation, transaction management, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all PIM reports based on search and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new PIM report with provided details and saves it to the database.

methods.name: setParamsToPimDefinedReport
methods.description: Sets common properties from request parameters onto a Report entity before saving or updating.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple PIM reports identified by IDs provided in the request body.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific report by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing report with new data, handling transactions for consistency.
